task: Extract and lock the selected start G4 location and all required current party context for G5 materialization.
guardrails: Do not invent or select a new G4. Return an error list if context is incomplete.

task: Find the exact G5 template for the selected g4_type_id and return its allowed, required, optional and forbidden anchor constraints.
guardrails: Do not use a generic scene if no template is found. Do not expand anchor lists without explicit source and audit flag.

task: Create a causally grounded G5 scene graph inside the selected G4 using the matched template and locked party context.
guardrails: No new G1-G4 nodes. No modern/fantasy anchors. Every anchor must help process visibility, access, movement, witnesses, items or interaction.

role: аудитор видимости, доступа, владения и риска
task: Audit each G5 anchor for what is visible, accessible, owned/controlled, witnessed and risky.
guardrails: Hidden facts must not be converted into visible facts. If hidden has a sign, pass only the sign.

role: агент привязки предметов и NPC к G5
task: Bind initial items, containers and NPCs to scene anchors only where the G4 function, situation and template justify them.
guardrails: Player request does not materialize items. Significant objects require owner/holder/access/risk.

task: Define short movement edges between G5 anchors and minilocations with time, access, visibility and risk.
guardrails: G5 edge time must be 0-5 minutes and stay inside selected G4.

task: Select the exact starting anchor and produce complete current_position fields.
guardrails: The selected anchor must exist in the G5 draft. Position cannot be prose-only.

role: агент безопасного видимого пакета стартовой сцены
hidden_allowed: yes, only to exclude hidden information
task: Prepare the visible-only package for intro prose after G5 materialization.
guardrails: Do not reveal hidden motives, hidden objects, exact future events, objective map, raw JSON or internal calculations.

task: Decide if the G5 materialization can be committed to party DB.
guardrails: Block commit on any missing FK plan, template violation, G1-G4 mutation, visibility leak or missing current_position.

task: Transform accepted G5 contracts into DB write plan.
guardrails: Only structure accepted facts. Do not add new anchors, items, NPCs or routes.
